resources.string: Full-screen Earth screensaver with local time, date and battery level. Touch to return.
The screensaver pauses sensors, GPS, camera and data refresh. Initial music volume: 20%.
Clearer compass calibration and interference notices, with location actions only when needed.
Tap a trajectory point to open the daily path centered on it, with a temporary highlight.
Compact object, date and time-zone heading; points 0–23, current position and lunar phases retained.
Capture labels include T+/T− countdowns. Refined main controls and object details.
